# ITechLK Store — llms.txt

## What is ITechLK Store?

ITechLK Store (https://itechlk.com) is Sri Lanka's trusted online marketplace for premium digital subscriptions. We offer carefully curated digital products including AI tools, streaming services, VPN subscriptions, creative software, productivity tools, and more — all delivered fast at the best prices in Sri Lanka.

## What we sell

- **AI Tools**: ChatGPT Plus, Midjourney, Claude Pro, Gemini Advanced, Copilot Pro, and other AI productivity subscriptions.
- **Streaming**: Netflix, Disney+, Spotify, YouTube Premium, and other entertainment streaming services.
- **VPNs**: NordVPN, ExpressVPN, Surfshark, and other private network subscriptions.
- **Creative & Editing**: Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva Pro, CapCut Pro, and other creative tool subscriptions.
- **Work & OS**: Microsoft 365, Windows licenses, and other productivity software.

## Who we serve

We primarily serve customers in Sri Lanka who need access to international digital software subscriptions at affordable, locally priced rates. We support Sinhala and English.
